    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Oracle Property Graph 结合 In-Memory 的性能验证</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <small>
<span id="post-date" data-last-update-days="0" data-date-updated="2026-09-19 06:37">2026-09-19 06:36</span>&nbsp;
<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao">AlfredZhao</a>&nbsp;
阅读(<span id="post_view_count">62</span>)&nbsp;
评论(<span id="post_comment_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="AddToWz(23034788);return false;">收藏</a>&nbsp;
<a href="https://report.cnblogs.com?targetLink=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cnblogs.com%2Fjyzhao%2Fp%2F23034788&amp;targetId=23034788&amp;targetType=0" target="_blank">举报</a>
</small>
    <div class="entry">
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>在之前的文章<a href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/6dDRlmPaCPmDKcmq2xQyLQ" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">理解Oracle Property Graph：以账户转账示例完成图特性最小测试</a>中，笔者用账户转账场景验证了属性图的基本查询能力。这次继续往前走一步：当图查询的数据量变大时，开启 In-Memory 到底能带来多少收益？下面用一条真实的多跳图查询来对比。</p>
<h2 id="01--准备测试数据">01 | 准备测试数据</h2>
<p>沿用之前的图查询，但原始数据只有 6 条，量太小根本用不上 IM。于是笔者快速补了 1 万条账户和 1 万条转账记录：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">-- 1. 生成 10,000 个账户（ID: 7 ~ 10006）
INSERT INTO money_accounts (account_id, account_name)
SELECT 
    6 + LEVEL AS account_id,
    '账户_' || (6 + LEVEL) AS account_name
FROM DUAL
CONNECT BY LEVEL &lt;= 10000;

-- 2. 生成 10,000 条转账记录（ID: 107 ~ 10106）
INSERT INTO money_transfers (transfer_id, from_account_id, to_account_id, amount, transfer_time)
SELECT 
    106 + LEVEL AS transfer_id,
    TRUNC(DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE(1, 10007)) AS from_account_id,
    TRUNC(DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE(1, 10007)) AS to_account_id,
    ROUND(DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE(10, 5000), 2) AS amount,
    SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE(0, 30), 'DAY') AS transfer_time
FROM DUAL
CONNECT BY LEVEL &lt;= 10000;

COMMIT;
</code></pre>
<h2 id="02--加载到内存列存">02 | 加载到内存列存</h2>
<p>要让 IM 生效，先把底层两张表标记为 INMEMORY，并强制 Populate：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">ALTER TABLE money_accounts INMEMORY;
ALTER TABLE money_transfers INMEMORY;

BEGIN
  DBMS_INMEMORY.POPULATE('SH', 'MONEY_ACCOUNTS');
  DBMS_INMEMORY.POPULATE('SH', 'MONEY_TRANSFERS');
END;
/

select SEGMENT_NAME, INMEMORY_SIZE, BYTES_NOT_POPULATED from v$im_segments;
</code></pre>
<p><code>bytes_not_populated</code> 必须为 <code>0</code>，才说明数据已全部进入内存列存。</p>
<h2 id="03--开启-in-memory-的测试">03 | 开启 In-Memory 的测试</h2>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SET AUTOTRACE ON;
SET TIMING ON;

SELECT *
FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
  money_graph
  MATCH (a IS ACCOUNT)-[IS TRANSFER]-&gt;{1,5}(b IS ACCOUNT)
  COLUMNS (
    a.account_id   AS source_account,
    a.account_name AS source_name,
    b.account_id   AS target_account,
    b.account_name AS target_name
  )
)
WHERE source_account = 1
ORDER BY target_account;
</code></pre>
<p>执行计划中，两张表的扫描方式都是 <code>TABLE ACCESS INMEMORY FULL</code>。多次执行后稳定结果：Elapsed 约 <code>00:00:00.110</code>，逻辑读 <code>614400 logical read bytes from cache</code>。</p>
<h2 id="04--关闭-in-memory-的测试">04 | 关闭 In-Memory 的测试</h2>
<p>图查询比较复杂，用 NO_INMEMORY Hint 有时不彻底，所以直接去掉表的 INMEMORY 属性更直观：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">ALTER SYSTEM FLUSH BUFFER_CACHE;

ALTER TABLE money_accounts NO INMEMORY;
ALTER TABLE money_transfers NO INMEMORY;

SET AUTOTRACE ON;
SET TIMING ON;
</code></pre>
<p>再次执行同一条查询，扫描方式变回 <code>TABLE ACCESS FULL</code>。稳定结果：Elapsed 约 <code>00:00:00.125</code>，逻辑读 <code>6897664 logical read bytes from cache</code>。</p>
<h2 id="05--该看哪些指标">05 | 该看哪些指标</h2>
<p>对比两组数据，重点看三个地方：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Elapsed Time</strong>：多跳传递路径涉及多层 Join 与递归关联，IM 的向量化过滤通常能明显缩短响应时间。</li>
<li><strong>逻辑读与物理读</strong>：走 IM 扫描时 <code>Consistent Gets</code> 显著下降，且不占用传统 Buffer Cache 资源。</li>
<li><strong>IM 相关统计项</strong>：可以通过统计项 IM scan CUs pruned 查看被 IM Storage Index 裁剪跳过的 IMCU 数量，而 IM scan rows 表示实际扫描读取的行数。</li>
</ul>
<p>本次测试中，开启 IM 后逻辑读从约 689 万降到约 61 万，差距非常直观。</p>
<p>关注我，和AI一起成长~</p>
